record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: A 2-convex 2-multi-norm is the same thing as an operator sequence space in the sense cited in the source. Do any of the results known for operator sequence spaces extend to suitable p-multi-norms?

evidence.quote: A 2-convex 2-multi-norm is just an operator sequence space in the sense of [ 12 ]. Do any results of [ 12 ] generalize to suitable p -multi-norms?

artifact.status_search_result: The theory of p-multi-norms has been actively developed by Dales, Daws, Pham, Laustsen, Oikhberg, Troitsky and others, and connections between p-multi-norms, power-norms and operator sequence spaces have been investigated. However, no source clearly states that the broad program of transferring all known operator-sequence-space results to p-multi-norms has been completed; the status of this open-ended research problem is therefore unclear.

status_evidence.title: Power-normed spaces
status_evidence.snippet: p-power-norms are defined ... a special class of ℓ^p-power-norms is shown to contain the p-multi-norms defined by Dales et al.
status_evidence.claim: Research has connected p-multi-norms with power-norms and operator-sequence-type structures, but the program is ongoing.

status_evidence.title: Multi-normed spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Theory of multi-normed spaces analogous to but distinct from operator spaces, related to L^p spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Multi-norm theory is being developed in parallel with operator space theory.
